labels.note: Segments built from split parts never contain literal '.' tokens, so url can never start or end with './'; both checks always true.
Keeps empty/'/' inputs, e.g. resolveURL(base, '/') now appends spurious slash to pathname instead of being filtered out.
Common case resolveURL(base) with no extra segments no longer returns base as-is; goes through reparse/stringify, risking silent normalization changes.
Same as removing the early return: resolveURL(base) alone stops returning base verbatim, reconstructing it via parse/stringify instead.
Forces pathname append even when segment has no pathname (e.g. query/hash-only segment), inserting a bogus extra slash into the path.
Disables hash override entirely; a segment's fragment (e.g. resolveURL(base,'x#frag')) is silently dropped from the result.
Forces search merge branch always; mostly idempotent round-trip via parse/stringify, only risks edge-case query formatting differences.
OR variant is logically always true (same as forcing the branch), same minor idempotent-recompute risk as the other search mutant.
